book.name: 1 TIMOTE
book.title: Mukaana wu a nsomo kundaa Timote

content: Bankana
Nyaã ti baara bwohono ba bali kunsa bunkana bagwa bamfumu ba bo budziri, mpaala banyaã otsaala nkwumu a Nzaami ya maluo ma bihi.

Ya bankana ba bali a bamfumu banga-a-kana banyaã okatsaala bamfumu ba bo mu kuulu bo bali bandughu mu kana. Lo bo bafaana okasalala bo ku obvulu bubwe mu kuulu bo bali mu okasalala banga-a-kana ya bandughu ba bo baba mukolo. Mamo ngu mandagha mafaana okaluo we ya okatumu.
Enzaami kii ngaŋma
Nswe mbwuru wu aakaluo maluo makimi, ya ka li mu okanama mandagha ma mabwe mama Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste o, ya maluo ma mali bwunu a bu oli enzaami,
nde ka li a ligyahaba o, mubili a nyuru aadzwi nde mihi. Nde li a bubyele bubu munsohobo ya mumbaŋana. Obo me bu ookagya sughu li mukolo, mitaha, otsaala, ya bitsimi bi bibi,
mimbaŋana mi migwene a masini ŋa kara li baara ba bali a mayele obyi. Bo ka basoolo engaŋma o, ya bo baakatsimi ti enzaami eli nzili yi obagha busini.
Ngaŋma, enzaami eli busini bu bunene kundaa munde wu aakamono esee mu yini a bi ali a nde.
Mu kuulu bihi-a-be ka líyabiri elogho mu nsie o,

content.text: bwunu obo si ŋa akala liimaara bihi-a-be ŋa nsie, ka libiri elogho o.
Kala ti bihi-a-be lili a bi-odza ya binkuru, bihi-a-be lifaana okamono esee mu bye.

content: Lo babo ba baakadzyi okala a busini, baakabwa mu bigyeele, baakakogholo mu mwere ya mu sughu li mukolo li linene ya li libi li liikasohobo baara kunsa obyi ya odzimini.
Mu kuulu ntono a nzi yiikaburu mandagha mwohono ma mabi. Mu nkooro a yo, baara bana baadzimini ya ka baafirisyili a kana o, ya bo baamwehẽ manyuru ma bomo mpara yi alagha.
Litumu kundaa Timote

content.text: Lo we wu li mbwuru a Nzaami, aakabara mandagha mamo.
We faana okasagha bunsumu, enzaami, kana,
We kadzwana mvulu yi mbwe yi a kana,
dzarala laama lili mibvu ya mibvu li báti we mbili mu lo,
ya liili we áasuo bumpughulu bu bubwe

content: Ŋa nkulu a Nzaami wu aakagwa byehene bi bili mweẽ laama, ya ŋa nkulu a Yiisu-Kriste wu áasuo bumpughulu mu mbiili yi mbwe yi a kana ŋa busu bu Ponse Pilate, me ngwi we litumu li:
Kebe litumu bu kala wene a mpiri, wene a mi baasyeme we, tee mu matala ma oomoŋono Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste.
Omoŋono oko sa okala, mu matala ma ókuru Nzaami,

content.text: yini a nde wuulu ka aakakpa o,
nde wu aakakala kunsa otsyeme kuulu mbwuru ka kughu osomo oko o,
otsyeme kuulu mbwuru si mumõ nkini ámaamono o, ya ka kughu omono o.
Nyaã ti nsia ya lileene bibi mibvu ya mibvu bikala kundaa nde! «Aamene!»

content: Bisini

Gwa litumu li kundaa bisini bi bili mu nsie yi banyaã okala a mubili a nyuru, ya banyaã osa emiini e bo mu busini buulu ka buukagyili matala malagha o. Lo bo basa emiini e bo mu Nzaami, nde wu aakagwa bihi bilogho byehene ku olagha mpaala bihi limono esee mu bye.
Nyaã bo bakasa bubwe, bakala bisini mu bigyighili bi bibwe, banga-a-kaba, ba baakabaha banganda.
Obo bo baakwu busini bu bubwe mu bomo mu bitsughu bi nkulu, mpaala babagha laama lili ngaŋma.
Mikele mimi masini
A we Timote! Aakakebe mandagha ma baagwi we. Aakabara mbiili yi mukaŋana yi aagwene faana ya kana. Ka akabaŋana mu mi mitala maluo mama ligyahaba lili mpya o.
Ndaama a baara yi aakatsimi ti yo yili a ligyahaba lilo, ka yiifirisyili mu nzili a kana o. Nyaã bwehe bu Nzaami bukala ya be!
